name: Warpriest War-Hound
body:
A war-hound lives for the chance to demonstrate his martial prowess on the field of battle, reveling in the chaos of swinging swords, sweat-drenched bodies, and blood soaked combat.

A war-hound has the following class features.

Special

A war-hound must worship a deity that offers the war domain, and he must select the war blessing as one of his two blessings.

This alters blessings.

Armor Training (Ex)

At 2nd level, a war-hound can expend 1 use of the fervor ability to gain the fighter’s armor training ability for a number of hours equal to 1/2 his war-hound level + his Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). This reduces the armor check penalty by 1 and increases the maximum Dexterity allowed by a war-hound’s armor by 1. A war-hound can increase these bonuses to +2 at 8th level by expending 2 total uses of fervor. At 16th level, a war-hound can increase these bonuses to +3 by expending 3 total uses of fervor.

This alters fervor.

Alpha Mentality

At 3rd level, a war-hound adds Skill Focus (Intimidate) to his list of bonus feats, in addition to any other feat that affects or utilizes the Intimidate skill (such as Persuasive), even if it is not considered a combat feat.

This alters bonus feats.

Combat Frenzy (Ex)

At 10th level, once per day, as a swift action, a war-hound can expend 2 uses of his blessings ability to gain 1 extra attack at his highest BAB when taking a full-attack action.

This frenzy lasts for 1 minute.

This alters blessings.
